summary: Temporal server MySQL persistence needs to support multi-host connections or SRV-based endpoint discovery to enable failover in Kubernetes/OpenShift environments without load balancers or VIPs.
userImpact: Users running Temporal in Kubernetes/OpenShift without load balancers cannot achieve automatic MySQL failover without manual reconfiguration.
rootCause: connectAddr implementation only supports a single host endpoint; multi-host failover and SRV-based discovery are not implemented.
proposedFix: Support comma-separated MySQL hosts in connectAddr for client-side failover, and/or support SRV-backed DNS names for endpoint discovery.
keyQuote: In environments without LB/VIP, we need Temporal server persistence to survive primary/node changes without manual reconfiguration/redeploy.
